name: Volt
summary: A transparent, tamper-evident ledger for peer-to-peer rooftop-solar energy trading.
contextNote: Built for the Open Energy Challenge 2026. All data is simulated — nothing real was metered or billed.

name: Vault -- cold-chain integrity console
summary: A frontend prototype for monitoring a vaccine shipment's cold chain. It simulates a temperature corridor in the browser, records events to a hash-chained ledger that can be verified after the fact, and tracks one box from loading bay to handoff.
contextNote: A frontend prototype for monitoring a vaccine shipment's cold chain. It simulates a temperature corridor in the browser, records events to a hash-chained ledger that can be verified after the fact, and tracks one box from loading bay to handoff.

name: CRASH — Chennai Road Accident Safety Hub
summary: A single-origin web application that maps road accidents across Greater Chennai, ranks the deadliest junctions by severity-weighted risk score, and turns every hotspot into an evidence-based intervention recommendation. Includes analytics dashboards, area comparison, citizen reporting, Monte Carlo simulation, and an AI data assistant.

name: pulse-fit
summary: Nine inputs. The engine derives body composition, energy demand, a training prescription, heart-rate ceilings and a recovery target — no wearable required.

name: Agrifly — Field Intelligence Survey Sheet
summary: A landing page for Agrifly, a precision-agriculture concept: "a survey that reads every parcel of your farm on a set cadence — so you act on what is happening now, not on what already went wrong."

name: Spikefit — The Fitting Room
summary: A rule-based, deterministic track-spike fitting tool. Answer a short guided quiz (or jump straight to your event), and get scored, explained spike recommendations — no external APIs, no ML, just a transparent rules engine over a real shoe catalog.
contextNote: project/ contains the original Claude Design handoff bundle (Spikefit.dc.html + assets) that the app/ implementation was built from. It's a static prototype, not runnable — kept for design reference only.

name: GAIKWAD — Interactive Tribute Microsite
summary: A single-page, scroll-driven fan tribute to top-order batter Ruturaj Gaikwad (No. 31). Built as one self-contained interactive experience: animated hero, pinned scroll-scrubbed storytelling, live canvas visualisations, a playable trivia quiz, and four switchable colour themes.
contextNote: Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any player, club, league, or board. All statistics shown are illustrative / approximate, as of mid-2026 and are used for design and demonstration purposes only.
